ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by accused Nos.2 to 4 seeking quashing of the proceedings pending in CC.No.719/2023 on the file of Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Chitradurga, for the offences punishable under Sections NC: 2025:KHC:34721 HC-KAR 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 36 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P.Act .
2.
Today, a joint memo has been filed before this Court, duly signed by accused No.1 along with his family members and respondent No.2-complainant/wife.
Respondent No.2 is present before the Court in person.

On being specifically queried, she has stated that pursuant to the intervention of Smt Vishalaxamma vs The State Of Karnataka By on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24644512/
2 elders and family members, an amicable settlement has been arrived at between herself and accused No.1.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She further confirms that she has now resumed cohabitation with her husband at the matrimonial home and, in view of the settlement, she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings.

She has, therefore, requested this Court to quash the proceedings pending in C.C.
No.719/2023.

3. Having regard to the fact that the parties, who are none other than husband and wife, have reconciled their differences and are now residing together, this Court NC: 2025:KHC:34721 HC-KAR is of the opinion that continuation of the criminal case would serve no fruitful purpose.
Rather, it would amount to abuse of the process of law and may disturb the peace that has been restored between the parties.
To secure the ends of justice, the proceedings deserve to be quashed.

4. In view of the amicable settlement arrived at between the parties, this Court finds it a fit case to exercise its inherent powers under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
5.

Hence, this Court proceeds to pass the following:
ORDER (i) The petition stands allowed.
(ii) The proceedings in C.C. No.719/2023 pending on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge and Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chitradurga, are hereby quashed.
